darwin.errorExcerpt:
handshake failed: MCP error -32000: Connection closed
--- stderr (tail) ---
Debugium — DAP debugger with real-time web UI + MCP

Usage: debugium <COMMAND>

Commands:
  launch    Launch a program under a debug adapter and open the web UI
  attach    Attach to an already-running debug adapter on a TCP port
  mcp       Start only the MCP stdio server (connects to a running Debugium port)
  sessions  List active debug sessions
  threads   List threads in the current session
  stack     Show the call stack
  bp        Manage breakpoints
  continue  Resume execution (continue)
  step      Single-step: over | in | out
  vars      Show local variables
  eval      Evaluate an expression
  source    Show a source file (windowed if --line given)
  context   Full debug snapshot
  annotate  Add a gutter annotation to the UI
  finding   Add a finding to the findings panel
  help      Print this message or the help of the given subcommand(s)

Options:
  -h, --help  Print help
